data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to share files and text with other apps
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to share text, files from storage or memory, and multiple files. It handles temporary file cleanup and supports separate activity mode on Android.
use_when: You need to share images, PDFs, or other files from your app
You want to share plain text or a combination of text and files
You need automatic cleanup of temporary files after sharing
avoid_when: You are building a pure iOS app that cannot use Swift plugins
You need to share very large files from memory
You require a single‑activity share flow without separate Android activity
strengths: Supports separate activity mode for Android navigation
Provides both storage and memory sharing APIs
weaknesses: Separate activity mode is default on Android, limiting result handling
Memory sharing methods can cause OOM for large files
data.setup_notes: Call Share.init() at app startup. For iOS, ensure the Flutter app is created with Swift or adjust Podfile to set SWIFT_VERSION. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Officially maintained, supports more platforms and has broader community support
